newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Ariston to issue statement on Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Ariston to issue statement on Cambodia.

text.p: Malaysian property developer Ariston Sdn Bhd, which is the single largest foreign investor in Cambodia, will issue a statement about the situation in Cambodia at 4 p.m. (0800 GMT) on Monday, an official with the company said.

Bitter fighting between forces aligned with Cambodia's prime minister has shut down businesses in the capital city of Phnom Penh. Southeast Asian airlines suspended their flights to and from the city on Sunday.
At least 12 people were killed and 50 wounded in the weekend's fighting on the streets of the capital.
Ariston is involved in a $1.3 billion Sihanoukville project involving the redevelopments of the Kang Keng airport, as well as construction of a casino ahd hotel resort on Naga Island.
Malaysia is Cambodia's largest foreign investor, with over $3 billion.
